description.value: Backyard Vineyards is an award-winning BC VQA winery in the Township of Langley, marketing itself as the bountiful backyard to Vancouver. Visitors can enjoy wine flights, charcuterie, and wine by the glass in the tasting room, or take bottles out to the casual first-come-first-served picnic area, which welcomes outside food and leashed dogs. The winery offers bubble tours, private event bookings, and a wine club, making it a destination rather than a simple tasting stop.
